blocks.text: ANTIPOLO — Choco Mucho turned to the tandem of Sisi Rondina-Rosales and Eya Laure anew to sweep ZUS Coffee, 25-20, 25-17, 25-20, and cruise to an early 2-0 lead in the 2026 PVL All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series on Thursday at Ynares Center Antipolo. Rosales once again came off the bench and led the Flying Titans with 15 points–all from spikes–while her longtime teammate Laure delivered 13 points and nine excellent receptions. “I don’t think I’d be able to do what I do on the court without my team’s support.
